The '''LCK 2020 Spring''' was the first split of the 2020 [[League of Legends Champions Korea]] season, organized by Riot Games and held primarily at LoL Park in Seoul, South Korea, from February 5 to April 25, 2020. The Regular Season followed a Double Round Robin format with Best-of-Three matches, while the Playoffs used a Single Elimination King of the Hill format with Best-of-Five series from Round 1 onwards. Ten teams competed for a ₩275,000,000 KRW prize pool, with the split champion initially qualifying for the [[Mid-Season Invitational/2020|2020 Mid-Season Invitational]] before its cancellation due to the COVID-19 pandemic. [[APK Prince]] and [[Hanwha Life Esports]] earned their spots through the [[LCK/2020/Spring/Promotion|Spring Promotion Tournament]]. The season was temporarily suspended in March before resuming online for the first time in league history. Matches were played on Patches 10.2 through 10.7.

==Format==
*'''Group Stage'''
** Double Round Robin {{Abbr/Bo3}}
*** {{bgcolortext|byeup|''1st place''}} advance to the Finals of the Playoffs.
*** {{bgcolortext|seedup|''2nd place''}} advance to the Semifinals of the Playoffs.
*** {{bgcolortext|up|''3rd place''}} advance to the Quarterfinals of the Playoffs.
*** {{bgcolortext|stayup|''4th and 6th place''}} advance to the Wild Card Round of the Playoffs.
*** {{bgcolortext|stay|''6th till 8th place''}} qualify for [[LCK/2020/Summer|Summer split]].
*** {{bgcolortext|down|''9th and 10th place''}} will have to play in the [[LCK/2020/Summer/Promotion|Summer Promotion Tournament]].
*'''Playoffs'''
**Top 5 from Group Stage
** Single Elimination King of the Hill.
*** Wild Card match is {{Abbr/Bo3}}.
*** Round 1 onwards is {{Abbr/Bo5}}.
** Winner qualifies for [[Mid-Season Invitational/2020|Mid Season Invitational 2020]]
